items.claim: The boundary_rationale overstates continuous rejoice/remember interleaving across v.7-10 and omits the undisclosed cross-seam imperative pairing that bears on where the aging-allegory wisdom_poem zone actually begins.
items.evidence: וְיִזְכֹּר֙ (remember, oshb:Eccl.11.8, tier: byte) occurs once in this row's span, not repeated at v.9 or v.10 (sweep: 7 verses book-wide, skeleton tier: refs Eccl.1.11, 2.16, 5.19=WEB 5.20, 9.5, 9.15, 11.8, 12.1) -- so "interleave continuously across v.7-10" overstates a single occurrence. The root's very next site is the 2ms imperative וּזְכֹר֙ (oshb:Eccl.12.1, tier: byte), which pairs with the row's own 2ms imperative שְׂמַ֧ח (oshb:Eccl.11.9, tier: byte) -- both addressed to the youth -- an undisclosed rejoice/remember imperative couplet straddling this row's own 11.10|12.1 seam. This bears directly on the owner-ruled aging-allegory wisdom_poem zone, whose own default bounds open at Eccl.11.9, not at the following row's Eccl.12.1 start; the row's rejected alternative addresses only the internal 3rd/2nd-person shift at v.8/9, never this stronger rival of ceding v.9-10 to the poem zone.

items.claim: The wisdom_poem boundary_rationale never engages why the poem begins at Eccl.12.1 rather than the owner-named zone's own Eccl.11.9 start, and the disclosed rejected alternative is weaker than this uncited rival.
items.evidence: The aging-allegory wisdom_poem's own default zone bound is Eccl.11.9, yet this row's span begins at Eccl.12.1; the preceding row (Eccl.11.7-Eccl.11.10) retains v.9-10, including the 2ms imperative שְׂמַ֧ח (oshb:Eccl.11.9, tier: byte) that pairs with this row's own opening imperative וּזְכֹר֙ (oshb:Eccl.12.1, tier: byte) on the paired root (remember-sweep: 7 verses skeleton tier; rejoice-sweep: 14 verses skeleton tier, refs incl. Eccl.11.8/Eccl.11.9). This remember/rejoice imperative couplet straddles the seam undisclosed. The offered rejected alternative (splitting v.1-7 into three rows at the anaphora sites) is a weaker rival than the undisclosed one: whether the poem's own start-boundary should move to Eccl.11.9 per the zone's own owner-ruled default.
